text:
Young inexperienced George changed his first Facebook ad every second day. New picture Tuesday. New headline Thursday.

Nothing ever settled. (Mystery solved. It was me.)

Meta counts a big edit as a fresh start, so its learning begins again.

Leave a new ad alone for four weeks.

Lots of Google searches now show an AI answer at the top, with links to websites underneath.

Google picks those links from pages already in its normal search results.

So the SEO that gets you into the normal results is the same work that gets you into the AI answer.

Best thing I said on a sales call this month: "You're not ready for ads yet."

Café owner in Mandurah. Opened six weeks ago. Four Google reviews.

Ads would only have spent her money faster.

Get more happy regulars and more reviews first. Then we talk.
